groups.label: Main flowers
groups.blurb: Pink, purple and blue blooms covering the cake tiers.

items.role: Pink hydrangea forming the soft pink clusters across the tiers.
Light purple hydrangea softening the pink field with lilac tones.
Light pink roses scattered through the arrangement.
Pink ranunculus adding rounded layered blooms.
Pink larkspur spikes lifting the top tier.
Blue larkspur bringing the blue notes through the middle tiers.
Misty-blue phalaenopsis cascading over the middle tier edge.
Green phalaenopsis climbing the upper tier beside the orchid cascade.
Pink magnolia blooms adding spring-tree accents.
Pink-white cherry blossom branches reaching across the top of the cake.

groups.label: Fillers & small blooms
groups.blurb: Small flowers filling the gaps between the main blooms.

items.role: Purple-blue clustered blooms dotted through the tiers.
Yellow mini daisies adding fresh yellow touches.
Light purple larkspur spikes threading through the pink field.
Pink bell flowers rising along the tiers.
Purple star sprigs filling the gaps.
White mini daisies lightening the palette.
Pink peonies anchoring the lower tiers.

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: Green foliage balancing the pastel blooms.

items.role: Green maple leaves adding crisp leaf shapes through the arrangement.
Soft feathery plumes threading through the tiers.
Fountain reed grass adding airy grass sprays.
Fine asparagus fern softening the edges.
Round eucalyptus leaves adding cool-green circles.

groups.label: Styling details
groups.blurb: Decorative details layered on the cake.

items.role: Pearl strands draped along the tier edges.
Yellow berry garlands ringing the tiers like small lemons.
